title: Is the credit any good? Four branches against twelve
design_ref: Credit assignment: a ladder of methods (checking credit quality)
purpose: On the trajectories of S05, estimate the same branch points' values again with twelve fresh branches each, as the reference. Compare each method's per-segment advantages with the reference: Monte Carlo with four branches, and trajectory-level advantages.
